rationale: This mutation resolves the -$10,999 cash deficit by formally embedding fertilizer application into the farm execution pipeline (Harvest -> Shed Deposit -> Fertilize -> Water -> Plant) to unlock massive Strawberry compounding, while synchronizing progressive plot expansion (6 plots at 3 hands, 10 at 5 hands, capping strictly at 14 plots by Day 13) to eliminate early worker idling without over-expanding acreage. It replaces the champion's margin-destructive 0.60x shed dump with a balanced two-phase liquidation regime (>=0.85x Days 1–8, >=0.90x Days 9–28, terminal sweep Days 29–30), enforces Strawberry Acreage Sovereignty with crop phase-gates, and purges phantom wheat hoarding when livestock is zero.
